basic_profile.bio: I'm a 17-year-old high school student from Austin, Texas. I have a keen interest in video editing, which I pursue using Final Cut Pro X. On weekends, I enjoy exploring local breweries with family and friends (though I stick to the root beer!). My love for makeup has grown into a small hobby where I exchange tips and products online. Typically, I'm online in the evenings after school and on weekends. I'm currently single and focused on college applications, hoping to study film production or media studies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've gained most of my video editing skills through self-teaching and YouTube tutorials. I also pick up tips from online communities focused on film and media. My understanding of makeup and beauty comes from personal experimentation and interacting with beauty subreddits.
